reason: Existing neutral-to-transformed decoding deficits do not distinguish coordinate change from low-rank/finite-sample decoder behavior. Full4096D Procrustes is underidentified by available training anchors; test a fixed64D pooled-training projection with within-condition ceilings, exact train-only semantic pairing and complete64-output categorical targets.
scope: Adaptive discovery sensitivity on already consumed structures, not final confirmation or a causal mechanism. A common 64-dimensional training PCA projection is fitted separately at each fixed site and feature backend, using all three naming conditions equally. This changes the earlier neutral-only fitting contract explicitly. Within-condition ceilings and retained variance describe projection loss; failure in this projection cannot reject harmless change elsewhere in the 4096-dimensional space. Train-only orthogonal alignment has full anchor rank in the projected space but is a fitted descriptive map, not a causal correspondence. Both canonical current and saved targets are always predicted together. Linear class scores are not calibrated probabilities. Frequency-matched shuffles preserve labels but do not equate all task complexity. Three shuffle seeds are controls, not independent replications. The pre_answer site precedes the later formatting-space correction and is not the actual digit boundary used by subsequent interventions. No ownership-control capture exists in this bank, so these results cannot isolate owner coding from value recovery or show natural use.
